# Recent lists completed work newest-first and honors its limit.
exec tuck$exe init
exec tuck$exe recent --json
json
stdout '"tasks": '
! stdout '"number":'

exec tuck$exe add 'Earlier completion' --state todo
exec tuck$exe done 001
exec tuck$exe add 'Later completion' --state todo
exec tuck$exe done 002

exec tuck$exe recent --json
json
stdout '(?s)"number": "002".*"number": "001"'
exec tuck$exe recent --limit=1 --json
json
stdout '"number": "002"'
! stdout '"number": "001"'
exec tuck$exe recent
stdout '002'
stdout 'Later completion'

! exec tuck$exe recent extra
stderr 'recent takes no positional arguments'
! exec tuck$exe recent --recent
stderr 'tuck recent: --recent is not supported'
